 Anyone would agree that 2026 has been the year for K-beauty. With new Korean brands launching in our retailers each week, you can't miss it; it's everywhere right now.
 From affordable Amazon K-beauty skincare products to being stocked on the shelves of your nearest Boots store, it's never been easier to get your hands on Korea's innovative formulas. In fact, brands such as medicube, Biodance, and Beauty of Joseon have quickly gone on to become household names.
 While most K-beauty products are already on the affordable side, you're almost always guaranteed to find further discounts on said buys – even more so during sale periods, such as Black Friday, which is taking place right now. So, we've scoured the web and found impressive deals of up to 57% off our team's most favourite K-beauty buys...

 Digital Beauty Writer 
 Sennen is Digital Beauty Writer at woman&home, where she shares the latest beauty launches, trending buys and personal product recommendations, from makeup and hair to skincare and nails. She is also a judge for the annual woman&home Haircare, Skincare and Beauty Awards. 
 Previously, Sennen achieved a First Class Fashion and Beauty Journalism degree at Birmingham City University, before undertaking her role as Junior Digital Fashion and Beauty Editor at FROW Magazine. During this position, she wrote about the latest industry news, new product launches, viral trends and thoroughly reviewed a lineup of beauty products. Since leaving FROW, Sennen has gone on to create fashion, beauty and lifestyle content with numerous brands, including Who What Wear UK, HuffPost UK and Harvey Nichols.
